content:
- Before interpreting forming `Qps[0]` as activity, trace both live `GetLineFloatValues` and historical `klineQPSDurationSeconds`/`cachedKlineQPSDurationSeconds`. As verified on 2026-10-03, current 1h QPS divides the observed cumulative quote turnover by the nominal 3599.999 seconds, not elapsed minutes; closed hours use the same denominator. Thus a comparison with `mean(Qps[1:9]) * 0.90` is a cumulative-volume gate, not an elapsed-rate or directional-flow gate. Preserve intentional `[0]`; recheck current runtime and independently aggregate only observed signal-time minutes, retaining canonical closed interval volumes.
- When extending a frozen study beyond ARM funding coverage, distinguish acquisition failure from strategy failure. The current research loader fills funding prefixes, not tails. If a genuine suffix is available, verify official `/fapi/v1/fundingRate` timestamps, rates and settlement mark prices against an ARM overlap, freeze/hash the response and require full gap/duplicate/end-coverage checks. An isolated research-data helper and separately identified cache/output can append those actual observations without changing production, databases, configuration, costs or the replay engine; do not silently substitute zero fees, funding, or synthetic marks. Verify exact original bar/funding prefixes and fully rerun all frozen controls on the extended window. Keep four complete years when explicitly requested; the shorter skill default cannot replace that gate. Report added months separately, and label calendar/45-month trade cohorts as attribution rather than separately initialized returns.
